prompts.Warship:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one new RUSSIAN CULTURE CLASSICAL AGE warship master for the overhead historical RTS Age of Fronts.
Input image 1 is the approved Bronze Age warship, a STYLE and camera reference only. Make a visibly more developed new vessel, do not alter the reference.
Pure vertical overhead orthographic camera, bow precisely screen-up and stern screen-down. Square RGBA canvas, genuinely transparent background. Complete centered boat, every oar tip contained with generous transparent margin. No water, wake, shadow outside boat, crew, text or sprite-sheet frames. Match the reference's beautifully painted thick timber, crisp contours, warm upper-left highlights and restrained large shapes readable at 24-48 pixels.
Regional Iron Age eastern-European forest/river inspiration, a game interpretation rather than a claimed archaeological reconstruction. A long narrow fighting boat with a continuous dark oak lower hull, BUILT-UP PLANK sides, visible transverse ribs, low planked bow and stern fighting platforms and a clear central rowing well. Substantially more constructed than the dugout reference. Thick straight planks, believable joinery, a few small plain dark iron fasteners; no medieval clinker longship styling or ornament.
Exactly SIX MATCHED PAIRS of working oars: twelve total, six port, six starboard, each pair aligned with one of six evenly spaced rowing benches. Oars sweep outward and modestly toward the stern. All six left oars parallel; all six right oars parallel. Each oar is a SINGLE STRAIGHT RIGID wooden object: its inner grip, shaft and elongated round-ended blade are perfectly collinear. Visible usable inner grips beside their benches, shaft crosses plain separate thole pin at gunwale; no bent handles, elbow, offset blade, ball joint or kink. All twelve complete blades clearly separate, generous margin, no cropping. Boat hull about four times longer than wide; total oar silhouette roughly twice longer than wide.
Combat role cue: TWO bold dark silver-gray forged IRON leaf-shaped spearheads and wooden spare spear shafts secured along the front gunwales, tips forward. Two dark red-brown leather-covered oval shields lie flat on the bow deck with restrained small dark iron center bosses, visibly strapped down. Clean reddish ochre wool/hide binding panels at the middle gunwales continue the older combat accent. No cargo. Interior contains six benches, central clear floor and practical timber supports only.
Avoid Greek/Roman trireme copies, naval ram, ballista, mast, sail, medieval dragon heads, rows of Viking shields, heraldry, flags, crosses, stars, Soviet or modern national symbols, modern guns, gold ornament, tropical outriggers, disconnected parts. Role silhouette, straight physical oars and strong clear iron weapon cue take priority over small decoration. One polished static production sprite.

prompts.Transport:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new Russian culture CLASSICAL AGE troop transport static sprite for Age of Fronts. Input image 1 (approved Bronze passenger boat) is a painterly style, lighting and directly-overhead camera reference only. This is a new later-age built-up timber vessel.
Pure vertical overhead orthographic, bow points screen-up, stern screen-down. Square genuine transparent RGBA canvas, one complete centered boat with 7% clear margin on all four sides. No background, water, wake, crew, external shadow, text or sprite frames.
Match crisp richly painted practical wood, clean highlights from upper-left and strong shapes legible at 24-48 pixels.
Subject: A BROAD, open, pointed-oval shallow-draft passenger river boat made from warm pale honey-colored PLANKS over visible stout oak ribs. Built-up side planks have credible joined seams and restrained dark iron fasteners. Dark brown thick continuous gunwales; pale inner wood makes the open bench layout instantly readable. Clearly more developed than the earlier birch-bark craft, no bark skin or rawhide inflatable appearance.
Hull is approximately three times as long as wide, open passenger interior occupies most of its length. EIGHT wide pale timber transverse benches spaced evenly with dark open floor gaps between them. Benches properly supported at both ends on the ribs and gunwales. Two small pale wool seat pads only at the very front and rear bench, retaining a clean light civilian accent. Large clear floorboards, no busy decoration.
Two complete straight wooden paddles are securely STOWED lengthwise along the inner aft sides, blades near stern; no projecting working oar banks. Small useful planked bow and stern landings. Every structural piece connected. Clear EMPTY passenger space, no cargo stacks, no weapons, no shields, no fighting paraphernalia.
Regional Iron Age eastern-European forest/river inspiration, specialized passenger layout is gameplay interpretation, not an archaeological reconstruction.
Avoid sails, masts, medieval/Viking dragon prows, Greek trireme styling, flags, religious or national symbols, armor, cannons, barrels, cargo or an exterior scene. One polished production static master with the role obvious from the broad EMPTY hull and many bright benches.
prompts.Trade:

Square genuinely transparent RGBA canvas. Pure perpendicular overhead orthographic, bow precisely screen-up, stern screen-down. One complete centered vessel, 6% transparent margin around all extremities. No water, wake, crew, scenery, outside cast shadow, text or animation frames.
Subject: a BROAD SHALLOW-DRAFT PLANK-BUILT river cargo boat with a nearly rectangular cargo well and tapered blunt bow and stern. Single watertight hull, not twin logs, not a raft. Stout dark oak outer gunwales, warm mid-brown wide planked floor, visibly connected ribs and restrained small plain dark iron seam fasteners. Low side walls visible ONLY by their tops/interior: no isometric exterior hull side. Overall hull approximately 2.3 times longer than wide, clearly stockier than a fighting vessel.
Fill its main deck with SIX deliberately large clearly separated strapped cargo masses in TWO columns of THREE: pale cream felt bale, warm gray rough iron ingots in a wicker basket, rolled brown furs, russet leather goods bundle, pale grain sack and one large round terracotta storage jar. Two straight wooden paddles stowed crosswise in neat loops across the stern landing, compact within hull. No projecting working oar banks. No passengers, weapons, shield racks, mast or sail.
Regional Iron Age eastern-European forest/river and steppe-contact inspiration; this specialized cargo craft is a gameplay interpretation, not a documented exact archaeological type. Practical timber, iron, wool, furs, pottery and grain.
